provider.readme:
# DeepSeek
DeepSeek's flagship chat web UI at [chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com). The browser bridge drives the logged-in session — free of charge for ordinary use, no per-token API fees.
**Models typically exposed** (subject to discovery on first login):
- DeepSeek-V3 — flagship 671B-A37B MoE generalist - DeepSeek-R1 — open-weights chain-of-thought reasoner - DeepSeek-Coder — code-specialized
**Why bridge instead of API:** the official DeepSeek API requires a Chinese phone number for signup. The web UI accepts a regular email signup and Google SSO from any region.
